title: Real classroom language arts: empathy and novel-study launch
learning_objective: Students reflect on empathy and multiple forms of intelligence, connect empathy to social commentary in literature, identify author techniques that create reader empathy, and plan novel-study reading/discussion routines.
common_misconceptions: Assuming intelligence is only measured by traditional school skills.
Defining empathy as simple sympathy rather than imagining and feeling with another person.
Treating social commentary as plot summary rather than an authorial message about the real world.
Making literary claims without evidence from the text.
